free_text: I recommend deferring biopsy because the guideline criterion explicitly advises against repeating a negative biopsy for a PI-RADS 3 finding that has not changed. This decision is supported by the retrieved radiology report showing a PI-RADS 3 lesion, and the prior status of a Negative biopsy. Although the PSA velocity was rising (5.99 ng/mL/yr), the lack of change in the imaging finding is the decisive factor overriding the trajectory.
